name: Henrika Domnathi // Henrika, Infernal Seer
oracle_text:
Flying
At the beginning of combat on your turn, choose one that hasn't been chosen —
• Each player sacrifices a creature of their choice.
• You draw a card and you lose 1 life.
• Transform Henrika.
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of combat on your turn, choose one that hasn't been chosen —
• Each player sacrifices a creature of their choice
• You draw a card and you lose 1 life

needs.what: a way for the authoring pipeline to produce a transforming double-faced card -- two linked card entries from one packet. NOTE: unlike the other two, the ENGINE already supports this mechanic (GameState.card_of, CardDef.back_face, primitives.transform, and the shipped bloodline_keeper / lord_of_lineage pair). Only the authoring path is missing, so this is cheaper than it looks and may be resolved by hand-authoring the card into data/cards/ rather than by any engine change.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The authoring pipeline emits exactly one card entry per answer file (`collect_answers` reads `answer["card"]` as a single dict), and a double-faced card is two card entries linked by `back_face`. Gate 3 compounds it: `collect_answers` looks the oracle text up by the payload's name, and a front face authored under its own name misses the catalog's joined "A // B" row. The repo's existing two-faced cards (bloodline_keeper / lord_of_lineage) are hand-written in data/cards/ for exactly this reason. Henrika additionally needs a `choose one that hasn't been chosen` mode tracker across separate trigger resolutions, which `ask_mode` does not provide.
